visuals.role: Original WordPad toolbar, status pane and sizegrip
Original My Computer toolbar and Rebar corroborated by browseui source

coverage_limits: Horizontal standard Toolbar with ordinary or flat buttons and ordinary flat separators. Split buttons, unexpected owner styles, vertical/wrapped separators and outer background remain native.
Horizontal standard Rebar grabber on default backgrounds. Keep native layouts, band data, children, text, image and explicit/bitmap backgrounds.
Single-pixel normal and pop-out StatusBar borders, native no-border, native text/icons/owner draw, and limited native sizegrip palette mapping outside the last pane. Simple mode uses native drawing.
Probes exercise controlled windows and real Windows painting and message APIs. Physical mouse or keyboard, RTL, high contrast, mixed-monitors and printer DCs were not exercised.

adjustments: Grabber hit tests passed with both manifests; additional pixel tests showed current system shadow differs from the source palette.
StatusBar reserved glyph width is read from the real last pane, without fixed scale; simple text uses the native GetWindowTextW public path.

Rebar explicit background setting is checked via its native public getter and the rendered fallback. Native WM_PRINTCLIENT was observed to retain the setting without filling the target with that color.
